code_vs_docs_metric.classification: during-project experiment/control receipt, not before-project planning

compressed_current_blocker_packet.current_blocker: candidate/proposer expressivity on fresh externally heldout rows under the native no-private-leakage contract
compressed_current_blocker_packet.kill_ablate_test: delete or disable native goal organ, learned proposer policy, public-I/O shape miner, and receipt-conditioned update; C must degrade or block versus matched A/B controls
compressed_current_blocker_packet.next_blocker_if_fail: repair candidate/proposer expressivity using the failed-row receipt as training signal; do not rerun unchanged policy
compressed_current_blocker_packet.next_blocker_if_pass: admit and run stronger ScienceAgentBench/RE-Bench/PaperBench validation or scale the D3 loop to fuller environments with field-level contribution claim

mined_techniques.forbidden_regression: same-slice family patching or manual row-specific fixes
mined_techniques.keep: Failed fresh-transfer receipts must become training signals for the next proposer.

mined_techniques.forbidden_regression: private-label leakage or fixed template victory laps
mined_techniques.keep: Mine public examples into reusable candidate shapes selected by public tests only.

mined_techniques.forbidden_regression: Codex prose selecting the next loop after the fact
mined_techniques.keep: The native organ must select the next action from receipts; deletion must block or degrade selection.

mined_techniques.forbidden_regression: unchanged prefix-policy reruns after a zero-score transfer
mined_techniques.keep: A learned candidate-space policy must be integrated and deletion-sensitive even when it fails on fresh transfer.

mined_techniques.forbidden_regression: duration growth, readiness, or harness hardening unless the receipt names them as blockers
mined_techniques.keep: A failed fresh row must become the next executable loop input, not a prose postmortem.

sha_convention: bytes on disk as-is (binary read, no line-ending normalization)
